resolved_findings.finding: The exponential semidensity was outside the declared coefficient algebra.
resolved_findings.repair: Defined the formal WKB semidensity space over C((hbar^(1/2))).

resolved_findings.finding: The zero-flux equation was quantified for one coefficient but promoted to an operator identity.
resolved_findings.repair: Defined a universal Delta-stable zero-flux domain and an admissible input domain.

resolved_findings.finding: Raw Berezin fiber integration was treated as an even chain map.
resolved_findings.repair: Introduced p_nu and derived the exact graded sign (-1)^p_nu.

resolved_findings.finding: The ordinary order-n QME right-hand side was called a cohomology class without proving closedness.
resolved_findings.repair: Defined o_n,rho and extracted d_0 o_n,rho=0 from the Bianchi identity.

resolved_findings.finding: Function Laplacian aliases Delta_X,nu and Delta_h,nu were undefined.
resolved_findings.repair: Defined both aliases from the compatible input and horizontal densities.

resolved_findings.finding: The classical ordinary action used inconsistent regulator-zero subscripts.
resolved_findings.repair: Unified it as S_ord,0,nu and tied d_tw,0,nu to that symbol.

resolved_findings.finding: The same C symbol denoted a function complex and a vertical scalar.
resolved_findings.repair: Renamed the function algebra mathscr O and the scalar C_ctr,nu.

resolved_findings.finding: The change of variables was used with an inverse derivative before invertibility was declared.
resolved_findings.repair: Declared mathscr T_nu an invertible odd-symplectic superdiffeomorphism at first use.

resolved_findings.finding: Canonical semidensity operators were applied directly to coefficient functions and scalars.
resolved_findings.repair: Introduced Darboux coefficient operators and wrote scalar-normalization commutation on semidensities.

resolved_findings.finding: The output prefactor expansion incorrectly allowed a general one-loop action while setting its leading amplitude to one.
resolved_findings.repair: Kept an invertible field-dependent A_0 and derived M_1=-log A_0.

resolved_findings.finding: Flat vertical data used a regulator-like zero subscript.
resolved_findings.repair: Renamed the objects rho_ctr,nu^flat and Delta_ctr,nu^flat.

resolved_findings.finding: Classical horizontal-vertical factorization was extended to all quantum corrections.
resolved_findings.repair: Stated that pulled-back M_n and H_Q,n can mix sectors and removed full quantum factorization.

resolved_findings.finding: Finite-regulator H0 and H1 were used without a preserved integer grading.
resolved_findings.repair: Used Hbar0 and Hbar1 by default and made H0 and H1 conditional refinements.

resolved_findings.finding: The integer degree of raw fiber integration was omitted.
resolved_findings.repair: Introduced q_nu and required q_nu=0 for integer-graded action and comparison claims.

resolved_findings.finding: The original antifield-zero vertical contour was assumed to give a nonzero normalization.
resolved_findings.repair: Computed S_ctr restricted to the zero section and the vanishing odd constant Berezin integral for the flat density.

resolved_findings.finding: The density-change master equation was inferred only from nilpotence, which determines it only up to a central term.
resolved_findings.repair: Derived it directly from compatibility of both semidensities.

resolved_findings.finding: The comparison subtraction did not explicitly assume both hBF actions satisfy the QME.
resolved_findings.repair: Added both QME hypotheses before deriving d_h D_n=0.

resolved_findings.finding: Canonical-transformation, parameter-shift, and vacuum terms in the comparison equation lacked types.
resolved_findings.repair: Typed R_n, delta g_n, and zeta_n and required parameter-independent bracket data.

resolved_findings.finding: RG maps were not declared chain maps and their parity-degree compatibility was omitted.
resolved_findings.repair: Typed the RG chain identities and required p_nu=0, plus q_nu=0 for the integer refinement.

resolved_findings.finding: The continuum local cohomology used an undefined differential and untyped quotient.
resolved_findings.repair: Defined the bracket limit, local-density lift, continuum CME bicomplex, and relative local cohomology.

resolved_findings.finding: K denoted both a vertical field and the composite chain map.
resolved_findings.repair: Renamed the chain map mathscr K_nu.

resolved_findings.finding: The density defect reused the regulator letter nu.
resolved_findings.repair: Renamed it chi_rho.

resolved_findings.finding: The Q-lift obstruction and Ward anomaly both used A_Q.
resolved_findings.repair: Separated mathfrak o_Q,n,nu from mathscr A_Q.

resolved_findings.finding: The vacuum constant collided visually with the gauge ghost c.
resolved_findings.repair: Renamed it zeta_n,nu.

resolved_findings.finding: The spacetime differential in relative local cohomology was undefined.
resolved_findings.repair: Defined d_sp on local spacetime form densities.

resolved_findings.finding: One pullback symbol was overloaded across functions, semidensities, densities, and differential forms.
resolved_findings.repair: Introduced coefficient-typed pullbacks T_nu,0^*, T_nu,1/2^*, and T_nu,1^*, reserving the unsubscripted symbol for differential forms.

resolved_findings.finding: The horizontal derivative was passed through a fiber integral without typing the base dependence of the cycle.
resolved_findings.repair: Declared the vertical cycle fixed over x and x^*; excluded varying cycles without a separate Gauss-Manin zero-variation-flux proof.

resolved_findings.finding: The complex logarithm in the Jacobian action shift had no chosen branch.
resolved_findings.repair: Fixed Log_k_nu(4i), computed the exact branch shift, and proved the semidensity is branch-independent.

resolved_findings.finding: The nonflat full-density ratio was not separately required to define a compatible BV density.
resolved_findings.repair: Expanded the half-density ratio exp(ell/2) and imposed Delta ell plus one quarter of the self bracket equal to zero.

resolved_findings.finding: The constant comparison class was quotiented out without stating that normalization remained adjustable.
resolved_findings.repair: Computed the normalization shift sign explicitly and required zeta_n=0 when normalized output is frozen.
